data.title: Turkey's Recep Tayyip Erdogan is waging war on the West and Israel - NATO must not ignore it | The Jerusalem Post
data.description: It is time to confront Erdogan about his much-too-close alignment with Russia, China, and Iran; his military occupation of northern Cyprus and northern Syria; and the war he wages against Israel.
